reports.scope: Paired Qwen3.5-2B FP32 pipeline comparison on one logical Ascend 910C device, changing only collection before waiting admission. Three workloads, one warmup per mode and three alternating measured pairs. Outputs, input-token work and clean final caches match. Two queued workloads use 17 rather than 18 forwards. 344 total forwards including warmups.
reports.limits: Short offline fixed-length generation, EOS disabled, early-first-result option disabled. Batch plans may change. Mixed-workload timing has a large temporal shift affecting both modes; all samples are retained and no stable throughput gain is established. No runtime trace, frequency or host-load series was collected; post-run health does not explain the slowdown. No new full-logit comparison. CPU tests cover ownership, capacity, EOS, option combinations and failure cleanup.
